capabilities: Convert pasted or selected URLs into card-styled links
Fetch Open Graph metadata (title, description, image)
Switch between card, compact and minimal layouts
Group multiple URLs into a scrollable carousel
Cache card images locally and mark cards as watched or read
extras: Not yet in the Obsidian Community Store; installable from GitHub via BRAT. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later.
problem: Pasted URLs in Obsidian stay as raw or plain markdown links with no visual preview of the target page.
summary: Link-card plugin that converts pasted URLs into styled cards with fetched title, description, thumbnail and favicon, plus scrollable carousels.
